text: 中国汽车工业协会12日发布数据显示，2026年7月份，新能源汽车月度新车销量占比首次超过60%、累计占比首次超过50%；月度出口量连续两个月突破100万辆，新能源汽车出口占比连续两个月超过50%。前7个月，我国汽车产销分别完成1756.7万辆和1760.2万辆，其中新能源汽车产销分别完成901.4万辆和900.7万辆，同比增长均近10%。7月，新能源汽车产销分别完成157.6万辆和156.1万辆，同比分别增长26.8%和23.7%，纯电动汽车产销量均超过100万辆，同比增长均超过三成。
text_en: Data released by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers on the 12th showed that in July 2026, new energy vehicles' monthly share of new car sales exceeded 60% for the first time, and the cumulative share exceeded 50% for the first time; monthly exports surpassed 1 million units for two consecutive months, with NEV exports accounting for over 50% for two consecutive months. In the first seven months, China's auto production and sales reached 17.567 million and 17.602 million units, respectively, with NEV production and sales at 9.014 million and 9.007 million units, both up nearly 10% year-on-year. In July, NEV production and sales were 1.576 million and 1.561 million units, up 26.8% and 23.7% year-on-year, with pure electric vehicle production and sales both exceeding 1 million units, up over 30% year-on-year.
